title: Virginia Apgar's birth chart
metaDescription: Virginia Apgar's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 16.3° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 16.3° Gemini. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Venus in the classical scheme — a air sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 26.8° Gemini, Venus was at 26.9° Gemini, Mars was at 7.8° Pisces. Read together: a mind at home in argument and pattern; taste led by wit and proportion; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Saturn to Uranus, a square with 0.1° of slack. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Mercury conjunction Venus at 0.2°, and Mars opposition Jupiter at 1.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Uranus opposes Neptune while both square Saturn. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mercury in Gemini at 26.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Virgo at 6.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aries at 20.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 4, water 2, earth 2, fire 1; modalities mutable 6, cardinal 3. Mercury and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Capricorn into Aquarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.8° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
